cīvaradussa.p: [Cīvara+dussa] (na) CL=10 Scarf, Clothing that is to sew as a robe.

R:
cīvaradussa：စီဝရ-ဒုဿ （န）
သင်္ကန်းလျာပုဆိုး။
DOP: cīvara n. [ ts ], one of the three robes of a bhikkhu (antaravāsaka, uttarāsaṅga and saṅghāṭi ), or one of the five robes of a bhikkhunī (those three plus saṅkacchika and udakasāṭikā ), especially the uttarāsaṅga or saṅghāṭi (prob. both sewn of pieces as a patchwork, and dyed a yellowish-red); one of the extra robes allowed; material for making the robe(s) ; Abh 296 (arahaddhajo ca kāsāyakāsāvāni ca ~e); Vin I 202, 14 (tassa lasikāya ~āni kāye lagganti); 255, 25 foll. (bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino ~aṃ ādāya pakkamati, tassa bahisīmagatassa evaṃ hoti idh’ ev’ imaṃ ~aṃ kāressaṃ na paccessan ti); 281, 35 (anujānāmi bhikkhave cha ~āni khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgan ti); 297, 14 (anujānāmi bhikkhave āyāmena aṭṭhaṅgulaṃ sugataṅgulena caturaṅgulaṃ vitthataṃ pacchimaṃ ~aṃ vikappetun ti); II 217, 19 (pattaṃ thavikāya pakkhipitvā aṃse ālaggetvā ~aṃ khandhe karitvā upāhanā ārohitvā); III 45, 25 (mahāpuññ’ attha tumhe āvuso, bahuṃ tumhākaṃ ~aṃ uppannan ti); 202, 35 (tassa taṃ ~aṃ kayiramānaṃ na ppahoti); 208, 30 (mayaṃ … mātugāmā nāma kicchalābhā, idaṃ ca me antimaṃ pañcamaṃ ~aṃ); 211, 34 (yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā ~aṃ viññāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti); 213, 1 (~aṃ nāma channaṃ ~ānaṃ aññataraṃ ~aṃ vikappanupagapacchimaṃ); IV 280, 4 (sā bhikkhunī taṃ ~aṃ visibbetvā Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā adāsi); V 117, 35 (dve ~āni gahapatikaṃ ca paṃsukūlaṃ ca); D II 163, 26 (ekaṃsaṃ ~aṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā); III 130, 6 (yaṃ vo mayā ~aṃ anuññātaṃ, alaṃ vo taṃ yāvad eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya daṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvad eva hirikopīnapaṭicchādanatthaṃ); M II 139, 21 (na ca tassa bhoto Gotamassa kāye ~aṃ accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti na ca accokkaṭṭhaṃ na ca kāyasmiṃ allīnaṃ na ca kāyasmiṃ apakaṭṭhaṃ); A II 209, 34 (so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena ~ena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena); III 108, 24 (bhavissanti bhikkhave bhikkhū anāgatam addhānaṃ ~e kalyāṇakāmā); It 102, 19 (paṃsukūlaṃ bhikkhave ~ānaṃ appaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca taṃ ca anavajjaṃ); Sn 339 (~e piṇḍapāte ca … taṇhaṃ mā kāsi); Th 127 (chavasitto va me patto paṃsukūlaṃ ca ~aṃ); Ja IV 25, 2 (bodhisatto pi ~aṃ sibbento nisīdi); VI 20, 17* (arahante sītibhūte sakkaccaṃ paṭipādayuṃ ~aṃ piṇḍapātaṃ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ); Nidd I 224, 27 (kiṃ samaṇassa mahagghena ~ena); Ap 567, 6 (saṅkārakūṭā āhatvā susānā rathiyāhi ca tato saṅghāṭikaṃ katvā lūkhaṃ dhāreyya ~aṃ); Sp 55, 11 (~aṃ ca uttarāsaṅgaṃ ca ākāse laggetvā nahāyituṃ āraddho); 177, 15 (pattacīvaraṃ ādāyā ti pattaṃ hatthehi ~aṃ kāyena ādiyitvā); 929, 5 (idaṃ udakasāṭikaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, na aññaṃ ~aṃ); Sv 1009, 34 (~asmiṃ hi tayo santosā); Ps II 212, 2 (bhikkhuno aṭṭha parikkhārā vaṭṭanti, tīṇi ~āni patto dantakaṭṭhacchedanavāsi ekā suci kāyabandhanaṃ parissāvanan ti); Dhp-a I 172, 16 (~aṃ nāma ekakena dukkaraṃ kātuṃ); Thūp 230, 18 (tumhe ~aṃ katvā pārupathā ti); — ifc see akāla- ( sv kāla 1 ), acceka-, acchinna- ( sv acchindati ), āvasatha-, kaṭhina- ( sv kaṭhina 2 ), kāla- ( sv kāla 1 ), gahapati- ( sv gahapati 1 ), jiṇṇatara- ( sv jarati 1 ), ti- ( sv ti 2 ), te- ( sv ti 2 ), thūpa- ( sv thūpa 1 ), paccāsā-, lūkha-, vassasāṭika-, vihāra-; — °- kamma , n. , the making of a robe; working on a robe ; Vin IV 60, 35 (āyasmā Udāyi paṭṭho hoti ~aṃ kātuṃ); M I 438, 10 (sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato ~aṃ karonti; Ps III 149, 24 : ~aṃ karontī ti manussā bhagavato cīvarasāṭakaṃ adaṃsu, taṃ gahetvā cīvaraṃ karonti); Mil 367, 25 ; Ps IV 157, 18 (~an ti jiṇṇamalinānaṃ aggaḷaṭṭhānuppādanadhovanādīhi kataparibhaṇḍaṃ pi cīvaratthāya uppannavatthānaṃ vicāraṇasibbanādīhi akatasaṃvidhānaṃ pi vaṭṭati); Pv-a 145, 8 (paccekabuddhaṃ ~aṃ karontaṃ disvā); — °- kārasamaya , m. [cīvara + kāra 1 + samaya], a time for making or working on robes ; Vin III 256, 4 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ~e bahuṃ suttaṃ viññāpesuṃ); IV 72, 27 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~e gaṇabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ); 100, 30 (~o nāma cīvare kariyamāne; Sp 813, 3 : cīvare kayiramāne ti yadā sāṭakaṃ ca suttaṃ ca labhitvā cīvaraṃ karonti tadā, visuṃ hi ~o nāma natthi); M III 110, 15 (~o no bhante vattatī ti); S II 277, 13 (na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karoti ~e); — neg. acīvara-kārasamaya, m. , not a time for making robes ; Ps IV 158, 4 ; — °- kāla , m. [cīvara + kāla 1 ], the (proper) time when robe-material is given ; Sp 722, 13 ; 1131, 22 (sakalaṃ pi ~aṃ saṇikaṃ saṇikaṃ denti yeva); Pj II 573, 28 (~e cīvarasaṅkhyaṃ vasanaṃ vā laddhā); — ~-samaya, m. , id. ; Vin III 261, 1 (te accekacīvarāni paṭi-ggahetvā ~-samayaṃ atikkāmenti); 261, 22 (paṭiggahetvā yāva ~-samayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ); 261, 36 (~-samayo nāma anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso, atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā); IV 286, 22 (kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya ~-samayaṃ atikkāmessatī ti); — °- gabbha , m. , the interior of the robe ; Ps II 237, 25 (~ena paṭicchādetvā); Mp IV 166, 18 (chabbaṇṇarasmiyo ~e paṭicchādetvā); — °- cetapannaṃ in Ee at Sp 674, 23 is wr for °-cetāpanaṃ or °-cetāpannaṃ; — °- cetāpana , °-cetāpanna, n. , some-thing to be exchanged for robe material; the purchase price for robe material ; Vin III 216, 11 foll. (bhikkhuṃ pan’ eva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa … ~aṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti iminā ~ena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī ti, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-cetāpannaṃ; 216, 25 : ~aṃ nāma hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā muttā vā maṇi vā … suttaṃ vā kappāso vā, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-cetāpannaṃ; Sp 670, 21 : ~an ti cīvaramūlaṃ, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee °-cetāpannan ti; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] II 406, 6 foll. : cīvaraṃ cetāpenti parivattenti etenā ti °-cetāpannaṃ, nakārāgamaṃ katvā °-cetāpannan ti vuttaṃ ~an ti pi paṭhanti); 1309, 4 (~aṃ, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee °-cetāpannaṃ); — °- dussa , n. [cīvara + dussa 1 ], (a piece of) cloth for making robes ; Vin IV 279, 32 (aññatarissā bhikkhuniyā mahagghe ~e cīvaraṃ dukkaṭaṃ hoti dussibbitaṃ); Vism 65, 2 ; Spk I 217, 6 (~āni ca saṃhariṃsu); Pv-a 73, 19 (~aṃ na ppahotī ti ñatvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr tassa hotī ti); — °- dhara , mfn. , who wears an ascetic’s robe ; Ps II 325, 31 (imasmiṃ hi sāsane ~o bhikkhu saṅghāṭiko ti na vuccati); — °- dhāraṇa , n. , ~ā, f. , the wearing of the (ascetic’s) robe; keeping a robe ; Vin V 139, 24 (dasa ~ā; Sp 1344, 13 foll. : sabbanīlakāni cīvarāni dhārentī ti vuttavasena dasā ti Kurundiyaṃ vuttaṃ); 213, 23* (dasa ~ā; Sp 1388, 26 : dasa ~ā ti dasa divasāni atirekacīvarassa dhāraṇā anuññātā ti attho); Th 975; Vism 106, 1 (~aṃ pi ca rāgacaritassa nātigāḷhaṃ nātisithilaṃ hoti); Utt-vn 664 (sabbanīlādayo vuttā dasa ~ā); — °- dhovana , n. , washing the robe or robe-material ; Sp 657, 17 (~’-atthāya); Ps I 299, 34 ( in long cpd ); — °- nidahaka , °-nidāhaka, mfn. , (one) who keeps or stores the material for robes ; Vin I 284, 1 (anujānāmi bhikkhave … bhikkhuṃ ~aṃ sammannituṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se -nidāhakaṃ; Sp 1121, 18 : ~an ti °-paṭisāmakaṃ, Be so; Ce °-paṭisāmanakaṃ; Ee, Se -nidāhakan ti °-paṭisāmanakaṃ); 284, 15 (~ā bhikkhū maṇḍape pi rukkhamūle pi nimbakose pi cīvaraṃ nidahanti, Ce so; Ee, Se °-nidāhakā; Be ~o bhikkhu … nidahati); — °- paccāsā , f. , the expectation of receiving a robe or material for a robe ; Vin III 203, 9 (atthi pana te bhikkhu ~ā ti); IV 286, 14 ; Sp 931, 10 (dubbalāya ~āya); — °- paṭiggāhaka , m ( fn )., (one) who receives robe-material (on behalf of the saṅgha ) ; Vin I 283, 19 (anujānāmi bhikkhave … bhikkhuṃ ~aṃ sammannituṃ; Sp 1121, 17 : ~an ti yo gahapatikehi saṅghassa dīyamānaṃ cīvaraṃ gaṇhāti); A III 274, 32 ; Sp 1122, 8 ; — °- paṭiviṃsa , °-paṭivīsa, ( °-paṭivisa), m. , a share or portion of material for a rob e; Vin I 285, 21 (anujānāmi bhikkhave … bhikkhū gaṇetvā vaggaṃ bandhitvā ~aṃ ṭhapetun ti, Ce so; Be °-paṭivīsaṃ; Ee, Se °-paṭivisaṃ); 305, 2 (kathaṃ nu kho gilānupaṭṭhākassa sāmaṇerassa ~o dātabbo ti, Ce so; Be °-paṭivīso; Ee, Se °-paṭiviso); Sp 1124, 1 foll. (dasa dasa ~e ekekaṃ vaggaṃ bandhitvā … ekaṃ ~aṃ ṭhapetuṃ anujānāmī ti … evaṃ ṭhapitesu ~esu kuso pātetabbo, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-paṭivīse … °-paṭivīsaṃ … °-paṭivīsesu); — °- paṭisāmaka , °-paṭisāmanaka, mfn. , (one) who stores or puts away material for robes ; Sp 1121, 18 (cīvaranidahakan ti ~aṃ, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se °-paṭisāmanakaṃ); — °- parivatta , m. ,, °- parivattana , n. ,, an exchange of robes ; Sv 602, 2 (kāyato apanetvā kāye °-parivattanaṃ akāsi); Spk II 200, 10 (°-parivattanaṃ katvā) ≠ Mp I 182, 29 (°-parivattaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr cīvaraṃ parivattaṃ) = Th-a III 135, 9 (°-parivattanaṃ); — °- pārupana , n. , the putting on, wearing, of a robe ; Sv 198, 21 ; Ps II 242, 35 ; Dhp-a III 340, 3 (bhikkhūnaṃ ~-kāle); — °- bhājaka , mfn. , (one) who distributes material for robes ; Vin I 285, 12 (anujānāmi bhikkhave … bhikkhuṃ ~aṃ samannituṃ); 285, 17 (~ānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi kathaṃ nu kho cīvaraṃ bhājetabban ti); A III 275, 2 ; Sp 1125, 2 (~ena imassa bhikkhuno koṭṭhāsena ettakena bhavitabban ti takketvā … cīvaraṃ dātabbaṃ); — °- bhājana , n. , the distribution of material for robes ; Sp 1131, 29 (~-kālaṃ sallakkhetvā); — °- bhājanī̆ya , n. , the sharing out, distribution of material for robes ; Sp 379, 8 (imasmiṃ ṭhāne kusasaṅkāmanavasena ~am eva ekaṃ āgataṃ); 1271, 26 (iti cīvarakkhandhake ~aṃ … vuttaṃ); — °- bhisī , f. , a roll of robes ; Vin I 287, 31 foll. (addasa … bhikkhū … ~iṃ karitvā khandhe pi ~iṃ karitvā kaṭiyā pi ~iṃ karitvā āgacchante; Sp 1128, 2 : ~in ti ettha bhisī ti dve tīṇi ekato katvā bhisisaṅkhepena saṃharitacīvarāni vuttāni); — °- bhoga , m. [cīvara + bhoga 2 ], the fold of a robe, where the robe is folded ; Sp 580, 2 (salākāyo pacchiyaṃ vā ~e vā pakkhipitvā āloḷetvā) ≠ 1261, 24 ; 979, 18 (kāyabandhanaṃ saṃharitvā ~e pakkhipitvā ṭhapetabbaṃ); Ps III 392, 13 (~’-antaraṃ pavesetvā pattaṃ udarena akkamitvā gaṇhāti); — °- rajana , n. , the dyeing of a robe ; Sp 983, 4 ; Spk III 36, 6 (janapade ~’-ādīni katvā āgamissāmā ti); — °- rajanaka , mfn. , (one) who dyes the robe ; Sv 924, 7 (~aṃ kappiyakārakaṃ pi adāsi, Be so; Se ~aṃ pi; Ce, Ee ~-kappiyakārakaṃ pi); — °- rajju , f. , a rope over which to hang a robe ; Vin I 47, 4 (cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā ~uṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ); II 121, 36 (bhikkhū jantāghare chamāya cīvaraṃ nikkhipanti, cīvaraṃ paṃsukitaṃ hoti … anujānāmi bhikkhave cīvaravaṃsaṃ ~un ti); 222, 10 (cīvaravaṃse vā ~uyā vā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā sādhukaṃ ataramānena vaccakuṭī pavisitabbā); III 48, 33 (bhaṇḍaṃ vehāsagataṃ hoti … cīvaravaṃse vā ~uyā vā … rukkhe vā laggitaṃ hoti); — °- lūkha , n. (?), roughness or shabbiness of robes ; Pp 53, 32 (ekacco puggalo ~aṃ vā passitvā pattalūkhaṃ vā passitvā … vividhaṃ vā dukkarakārikaṃ passitvā; Pp-a 229, 28 : ~an ti cīvarassa dubbaṇṇādibhāvena lūkhataṃ); Ps II 2, 20 (lūkhappamāṇo pi bhagavato ~aṃ disvā); — °- lesa , m. , an oblique or indirect statement connected with a robe ; Vin III 169, 30 (~o nāma paṃsukūliko diṭṭho hoti … gahapaticīvaradharo diṭṭho hoti …); — °- vaṃsa , m. , a bamboo rod over which to hang a robe ; Vin II 121, 36 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ cīvararajjun ti); III 261, 2 (tāni cīvarāni ~e bhaṇḍikābaddhāni tiṭṭhanti); Ja I 9, 12 (~e laggitaṃ … vākacīraṃ gahetvā); Sp 325, 17 (~e ti cīvaraṭhapanatthāya bandhitvā ṭhapite vaṃse vā kaṭṭha-daṇḍake vā); Dhp-a III 342, 13 (cīvaraṃ … saṃharitvā ~e ṭhapetvā); — °- vaḍḍhaka , m. , a cutter or maker of robes, a tailor ; Ja I 220, 16 foll. ; — °- vāyāpana , n. , having robe material woven ; Sp 1309, 14 (suttaṃ viññāpetvā ~aṃ); — °- vicāraṇa , n. , considering, planning (the making of) a robe ; Vin I 254, 28 (na ~-mattena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ; Sp 1110, 20 foll. : pañcakaṃ vā sattakaṃ vā navakaṃ vā ekādasakaṃ vā hotū ti evaṃ vicāraṇamattena); Sv 1043, 33 (~’-ādikammaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti); — °- vippavāsa , m. , being away from one’s robe(s) ; Sp 1107, 2 (asamādāna-cāro ti ticīvaraṃ asamādāya caraṇaṃ, ~o kappissatī ti attho); Th-a II 155, 9 ; — °- vibhaṅga , m. , the distribution of material for robes ; Vin IV 284, 17 (na tāva cīvaraṃ bhājiyissatī ti ~aṃ paṭibāhati); Sp 1308, 4 ; — °- saṅkamanīya , n. , a robe which is to be handed back ;? a borrowed robe ;? Vin IV 282, 25 (yā pana bhikkhunī ~aṃ dhāreyya, pācittiyan ti; 282, 28 foll. : ~aṃ nāma upasampannāya pañcannaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ tassā vā adinnaṃ taṃ vā anāpucchā nivāseti vā pārupati vā āpatti pācittiyassa; Sp 930, 4 ; ~an ti saṅkametabbaṃ cīvaraṃ aññissā santakaṃ anāpucchā gahitaṃ puna paṭidātabbacīvaran ti attho); 1311, 24 (~aṃ dhāreyya); — °- sāṭaka , m. , (a strip of) cloth for making robes ; Ja IV 117, 20 (rājā tesaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā pasannacitto ~e ca bhesajjāni datvā paccekabuddhe uyyojesi); Ps III 149, 24 (manussā bhagavato ~aṃ adaṃsu, taṃ gahetvā cīvaraṃ karonti); Spk I 308, 22 (tena hi tāta upasampadaṃ karohī ti ~e adāsi, so ticīvaraṃ kārāpetvā upasampanno …); — °- sāṇi , f. , a screen made of a robe ; Spk II 234, 17 (rattiṃ pana nesaṃ antare ~iṃ pasārenti); — °- hetu , ind. , for the sake of a robe ; Vin IV 58, 13 (āmisahetū ti ~u piṇḍapātahetu …); D III 224, 25 (na ca ~u anesanaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ āpajjati); M I 105, 23 (na kho panāhaṃ ~u agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito); A II 248, 26 (~u … bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati); Nidd I 269, 6 (~u … sampajānamusā bhāsati); — acīvara , mfn. , without a robe ; Vin I 99, 31* ( in uddāna); — aticīvara , n. , extra robe-material ;? Sp 1131, 19 (kālacīvaraṃ pi saṅghassa ito va dassāma, visuṃ sajjiyamāne ~aṃ hotī ti, Ee, Se so , perhaps wr; Be, Ce aticiraṃ); — sacīvara , mfn. , 1. with a robe, wearing a robe ; Th 1102 (kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho navena toyena ~aṃ … ovassate); Vism 66, 3* (sapattacaraṇo pakkhī va ~o va yogivaro); — 2. together with a robe or material for a robe ; Vin I 299, 30 (manussā … ~āni bhattāni adaṃsu); Ja I 41, 25 (~aṃ mahādānaṃ pavattetvā); — ~-bhatta, n. , a meal and robe material ; Vin III 265, 4 (aññatarassa pūgassa saṅghassa ~-bhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti bhojetvā cīvarena acchādessāmā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cīvarabhattaṃ); IV 72, 12 (manussā cīvaradānasamaye ~-bhattaṃ paṭiyādetvā); Sv 133, 21 (buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhu-saṅghaṃ ~-bhattena santappetvā); — see also acīvaraka, acchinnacīvaraka ( sv acchindati ), jiṇṇacīvaraka ( sv jarati 1 ), tintacīvaraka ( sv temati ), tecīvari(n), tecīvarika, naṭṭhacīvarikā ( sv nassati ).
NCP: neuter | ciivaradussa (a piece of) cloth for making robes.

cīvaradāna.p: [Cīvara+dāna] (na) CL=10 (1) Robe donation; Donation, giving, allocation of robes - (2) Allocation of robes. See-Cīvaradānavattha. (3) When donation, giving, allocation of robes (4) The time of giving the robe, which is given away. See-Cīvaradānasamaya.
a: (၁)သင်္ကန်းအလှူ၊ သင်္ကန်းကို-လှူဒါန်း-ပေးကမ်း-စွန့်ကြဲ-ဝေငှ-ခြင်း။(၂)သင်္ကန်းကို ပေးဝေခြင်း။ စီဝရဒါနဝတ္တ-ကြည့်။(၃)သင်္ကန်းကို-လှူဒါန်း-ပေးကမ်း-စွန့်ကြဲ-ဝေငှ-ရာအခါ။(၎)စွန့်အပ်ပြီးသော သင်္ကန်းကို ပေးရာအခါ။ စီဝရဒါနသမယ-ကြည့်။

（၁） သင်္ကန်းအလှူ၊ သင်္ကန်းကို-လှူဒါန်း-ပေးကမ်း-စွန့်ကြဲ-ဝေငှ-ခြင်း။ （၂） သင်္ကန်းကို ပေးဝေခြင်း။ စီဝရဒါနဝတ္တ-ကြည့်။ （၃） သင်္ကန်းကို-လှူဒါန်း-ပေးကမ်း-စွန့်ကြဲ-ဝေငှ-ရာအခါ။ （၄） စွန့်အပ်ပြီးသော သင်္ကန်းကို ပေးရာအခါ။ စီဝရဒါနသမယ-ကြည့်။

cīvaradhāraṇa.p: [Cīvara+dhāraṇa] (na) CL=10 Bearing a robe; Wearing a robe. (2) Bearing a robe without making a vow. Putting on the robe without making any vows. (3) How to wear a robe.
a: သင်္ကန်းကို-ဆောင်ခြင်း၊ ဝတ်ရုံခြင်း။(၂)အဓိဋ္ဌာန်မတင် ဝိကပ္ပနာမပြုသော သင်္ကန်းကို ဆောင်ခြင်း၊ အဓိဋ္ဌာန်မတင် ဝိကပ္ပနာ မပြုဘဲသင်္ကန်းကို ထားခြင်း။(၃)သင်္ကန်း-ဝတ်ပုံ-ရုံပုံ-ကိုင်ဆောင်ပုံ။

Sp 1131, 19 (kālacīvaraṃ pi saṅghassa ito va dassāma, visuṃ sajjiyamāne ~aṃ hotī ti, Ee, Se so , perhaps wr; Be, Ce aticiraṃ); — sacīvara , mfn. , 1. with a robe, wearing a robe ; Th 1102 (kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho navena toyena ~aṃ … ovassate); Vism 66, 3* (sapattacaraṇo pakkhī va ~o va yogivaro); — 2. together with a robe or material for a robe ; Vin I 299, 30 (manussā … ~āni bhattāni adaṃsu); Ja I 41, 25 (~aṃ mahādānaṃ pavattetvā); — ~-bhatta, n. , a meal and robe material ; Vin III 265, 4 (aññatarassa pūgassa saṅghassa ~-bhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti bhojetvā cīvarena acchādessāmā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cīvarabhattaṃ); IV 72, 12 (manussā cīvaradānasamaye ~-bhattaṃ paṭiyādetvā); Sv 133, 21 (buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhu-saṅghaṃ ~-bhattena santappetvā); — see also acīvaraka, acchinnacīvaraka ( sv acchindati ), jiṇṇacīvaraka ( sv jarati 1 ), tintacīvaraka ( sv temati ), tecīvari(n), tecīvarika, naṭṭhacīvarikā ( sv nassati ).
